# Introduction

The purpose of this notebook is to compare the Eswatini model output against the calibration targets in the
`Obs-` sheets of the calibration ingest form.

1. Adult (15-49) HIV prevalence over time, by gender
2. Age-prevalence curves in 5-year age bins, by gender and survey year
3. Population by 5-year age bin (and total population), by gender

Calibration targets come from `Obs-Prevalence` and `Obs-Population` in the ingest form used by `optim_script.py`
(`calibration_ingest_form-Swaziland--UPDATED--2024-01-14.xlsm`).

# Libraries
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
library(magrittr)
library(readxl)
```

## Constants
```{r}
SWZ_CENSUS_YEAR = 2017
SWZ_CENSUS_POP = 1148000 # UN WPP 2019, according to SWZ national census 2017 1093238

ADULT_AGE_MIN = 15 # inclusive
ADULT_AGE_MAX = 50 # exclusive

current_date <- Sys.Date()
date_string_ymd <- format(current_date, format = "%Y%m%d")

ingest.file.base = "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/SWZ_calib/Data/calibration_ingest_form-Swaziland--UPDATED--2024-01-14.xlsm"
```

## Functions
```{r}
# Get the lower and upper ages out of an ingest-form age bin label, e.g. "[15:20)" -> 15, 20
agebin.min <- function(AgeBin){as.numeric(str_extract(AgeBin, "(?<=\\[)[0-9]+"))}
agebin.max <- function(AgeBin){as.numeric(str_extract(AgeBin, "(?<=:)[0-9]+"))}

# Assign each simulated age to the ingest-form age bin that contains it.
# age_bin_labels is a vector of labels like "[15:20)", "[20:25)", ..., "[65:99)"
# Ages outside of all of the bins are given NA
assign.age.bin <- function(Age, age_bin_labels){
  age_bin_labels <- age_bin_labels[order(agebin.min(age_bin_labels))]
  breaks <- c(agebin.min(age_bin_labels), Inf)
  # The last bin is open-ended (e.g. [65:99) includes everyone 65+)
  AgeBin <- cut(Age, breaks = breaks, right = FALSE, labels = age_bin_labels)
  factor(AgeBin, levels = age_bin_labels)
}

# Read one "Obs-" sheet from the calibration ingest form.
# The sheet has a metadata block on top; the data table starts at the last row whose first cell is "Year".
read.obs.sheet <- function(ingest_filename, sheet){
  raw <- read_excel(ingest_filename, sheet, col_names = FALSE, .name_repair = "minimal")
  header_row <- max(which(raw[[1]] == "Year"))
  read_excel(ingest_filename, sheet, skip = header_row - 1, .name_repair = "unique_quiet") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Year), !is.na(AgeBin))
}

# Read ReportHIVByAgeAndGender.csv from every Simulation_* folder in an experiment,
# summing summarize_columns within stratify_columns. Column names are cleaned the same way as
# data.table::fread(check.names = TRUE), e.g. "Newly Infected" -> "Newly.Infected"
read.sim.results <- function(experiment_path, scenario_name, summarize_columns, stratify_columns){
  files <- Sys.glob(file.path(experiment_path, "Simulation_*", "output", "ReportHIVByAgeAndGender.csv"))
  print(paste("Found", length(files), "output files for scenario", scenario_name))

  map_dfr(files, function(f){
    read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = ~ make.names(str_trim(.x))) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(stratify_columns))) %>%
      summarize(across(all_of(summarize_columns), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      mutate(sim.id = f, scenario_name = scenario_name)
  })
}

# Prevalence = sum(Infected)/sum(Population) within each stratum
calc.prevalence <- function(data, stratify_columns){
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(stratify_columns))) %>%
    summarize(Infected = sum(Infected), Population = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    mutate(Prevalence = if_else(Population > 0, Infected/Population, 0))
}
```

# Read in data

## Simulation results
```{r}
# Most recent baseline (demo_test branch)
experiment.path = "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/eSwatini/Baseline-campaign_20250715_duet-demo_test_baseline___2026_11_05_14_27_10_253189/"

sim.results <- read.sim.results(
  experiment_path = experiment.path,
  scenario_name = "baseline",
  summarize_columns = c("Population","Infected", "On_ART",
                        "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                        "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed"),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Gender", "Age")
)

sim.results.pop.scaling <- sim.results %>%
  filter(Year == SWZ_CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
  group_by(sim.id, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(pop.scaling.factor = SWZ_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

sim.results <- sim.results %>%
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.id", "scenario_name")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Gender = case_when(Gender==0 ~ "Male", Gender==1 ~ "Female"))
```

## Calibration targets

95% bounds are computed the same way as the calibration does:

* Prevalence: Beta(x + 1, n - x + 1) quantiles, with n = `effective_count` and x = Prevalence * n
* Population: Population ± 1.96 * (`two_sigma`/2)

```{r}
obs.prev.sheet <- read.obs.sheet(ingest.file.base, "Obs-Prevalence") %>%
  select(Year, Gender, AgeBin, Prevalence, effective_count) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Year, Prevalence, effective_count), as.numeric),
         lb = qbeta(0.025, Prevalence * effective_count + 1, effective_count - Prevalence * effective_count + 1),
         ub = qbeta(0.975, Prevalence * effective_count + 1, effective_count - Prevalence * effective_count + 1),
         AgeMin = agebin.min(AgeBin), AgeMax = agebin.max(AgeBin))

obs.pop.sheet <- read.obs.sheet(ingest.file.base, "Obs-Population") %>%
  select(Year, Gender, AgeBin, Population, two_sigma) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Year, Population, two_sigma), as.numeric),
         lb = Population - 1.96 * two_sigma/2,
         ub = Population + 1.96 * two_sigma/2,
         AgeMin = agebin.min(AgeBin), AgeMax = agebin.max(AgeBin))

obs.prev.sheet %>% head
obs.pop.sheet %>% head
```

# Adult prevalence vs time

The `Obs-Prevalence` sheet only has prevalence by 5-year age bin, so the adult (15-49) target is built by
weighting each age bin's observed prevalence by the simulated population in that age bin
(mean across simulations, same year and gender). The 95% CI combines the binomial variance from each age bin
using its `effective_count`:

$$\hat p = \sum_i w_i p_i, \qquad \mathrm{Var}(\hat p) = \sum_i w_i^2 \frac{p_i (1 - p_i)}{n_i}$$

The published national survey estimates (DHS 2006, SHIMS 2011, SHIMS2 2016, SHIMS3 2021) used in previous
notebooks are also plotted as open circles for reference.

## Load and transform data
```{r}
# Published survey estimates for adults 15-49, used in swz_calib_check.Rmd and HBP_outputs.Rmd
prev.15.49 <- data.table(Year = c(2006, 2006, 2011,2011, 2016, 2016, 2021, 2021),
                         Gender = c("Female", "Male"),
                         prev = c(31.36998255, 19.54469739, 38.79583333, 24.3101129, 34.67579541, 19.87162343, 32.01485259, 16.34463925)/100,
                         lb = c(30.02809341, 18.26093783, 37.83139223,23.39183621, 33.35133936,18.60315482,31.85041561, 16.21699044)/100,
                         ub = c(32.73564238, 20.87807258, 39.76691062, 25.2464012, 36.01828845,21.18736119, 32.17962673, 16.4728948)/100)

# Simulated adult prevalence
data <- calc.prevalence(
  sim.results %>% filter(Age >= ADULT_AGE_MIN, Age < ADULT_AGE_MAX),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Gender", "sim.id", "scenario_name"))

prev.data.mean <- data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year, Gender, scenario_name) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean.Prevalence = mean(Prevalence),
                     lower = quantile(Prevalence, probs = 0.025),
                     upper = quantile(Prevalence, probs = 0.975),
                     .groups = 'keep') %>%
  ungroup()

# Simulated population in each obs age bin, used as weights for aggregating the age-specific targets
obs.prev.adult <- obs.prev.sheet %>%
  filter(AgeMin >= ADULT_AGE_MIN, AgeMax <= ADULT_AGE_MAX)

sim.pop.weights <- sim.results %>%
  filter(Year %in% unique(obs.prev.adult$Year)) %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = assign.age.bin(Age, unique(obs.prev.adult$AgeBin))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AgeBin), Age < ADULT_AGE_MAX) %>%
  group_by(Year, Gender, AgeBin, sim.id) %>%
  summarize(Population = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(Year, Gender, AgeBin) %>%
  summarize(Population = mean(Population), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = as.character(AgeBin))

obs.prev.adult.agg <- obs.prev.adult %>%
  inner_join(sim.pop.weights, by = c("Year", "Gender", "AgeBin")) %>%
  group_by(Year, Gender) %>%
  mutate(w = Population/sum(Population)) %>%
  summarize(prev = sum(w * Prevalence),
            se = sqrt(sum(w^2 * Prevalence * (1 - Prevalence)/effective_count)),
            n.agebins = n(),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(lb = pmax(prev - 1.96 * se, 0),
         ub = prev + 1.96 * se)

obs.prev.adult.agg
```

## Plot
```{r, fig.width = 8}
plot.prev <- ggplot() +

                aes(x = Year, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, group = scenario_name, fill = Gender),
```

# Prevalence vs age over time

## Load and transform data
```{r}
subset_years = sort(unique(obs.prev.sheet$Year))   # 2007, 2011, 2016, 2021

# Use the widest set of age bins in the obs sheet, [15:20) ... [65:99)
age_labels <- unique(obs.prev.sheet$AgeBin)
age_labels <- age_labels[order(agebin.min(age_labels))]

# Subset data on years
data <- sim.results %>% filter(Year %in% subset_years)

# Label each age by its bin
data <- data %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = assign.age.bin(Age, age_labels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AgeBin))

# Calculate prevalence, grouping by age bin
data.prev <- data %>% calc.prevalence(
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "AgeBin", "Gender", "scenario_name", "sim.id"))

# Calculate mean prevalence across all sim runs
ageprev.data.mean <- data.prev %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, AgeBin, Gender, scenario_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean.Prevalence = mean(Prevalence),
                   lower = quantile(Prevalence, probs = 0.025),
                   upper = quantile(Prevalence, probs = 0.975),
                   .groups = 'keep') %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = factor(AgeBin, levels = age_labels))

# Reformat the prevalence data
obs.prev.sheet <- obs.prev.sheet %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = factor(AgeBin, levels = age_labels))
```

# Population by age over time

Third check against the other calibration channel, `Obs-Population` (UN WPP, 5-year age bins in 2000, 2005, ..., 2020).
Simulated population is rescaled so that the total population in `r SWZ_CENSUS_YEAR` matches `r format(SWZ_CENSUS_POP, big.mark = ",")`.
Only the obs years that fall inside the simulation's reporting window are plotted.

Note that `ReportHIVByAgeAndGender` only reports in the age bins it was configured with
(currently 0, 15, 20, ..., 60, 65, 99), so `Age == 0` is everyone under 15 and `Age == 65` is everyone 65-98.
The 5-year WPP bins are summed up to match the report's bins before comparing (`two_sigma` added in quadrature, bounds are ± 1.96 * `two_sigma`/2 as above).

## Load and transform data
```{r}
# Age bins as reported by the simulation; 99 is folded into the last (open-ended) bin
sim_age_breaks <- sort(unique(sim.results$Age))
sim_age_breaks <- sim_age_breaks[sim_age_breaks < 99]
pop_age_labels <- paste0("[", sim_age_breaks, ":", c(sim_age_breaks[-1], 99), ")")
pop_age_labels

# Re-bin the obs sheet to match the simulation's reporting bins
obs.pop.sheet.rebin <- obs.pop.sheet %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = as.character(assign.age.bin(AgeMin, pop_age_labels))) %>%
  group_by(Year, Gender, AgeBin) %>%
  summarize(Population = sum(Population),
            two_sigma = sqrt(sum(two_sigma^2)),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(lb = Population - 1.96 * two_sigma/2, ub = Population + 1.96 * two_sigma/2)

pop_subset_years <- intersect(unique(obs.pop.sheet$Year), unique(sim.results$Year))
pop_subset_years

# Subset data on years, label each age by its bin
data <- sim.results %>%
  filter(Year %in% pop_subset_years) %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = assign.age.bin(Age, pop_age_labels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AgeBin))

# Count total people in each age bin, scaled up to the national population
pop.data <- data %>%
  group_by(Year, Gender, AgeBin, scenario_name, sim.id) %>%
  summarize(Population = sum(Population * pop.scaling.factor), .groups = 'keep') %>%
  group_by(Year, Gender, AgeBin, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(mean.Population = mean(Population),
            lower = quantile(Population, probs = 0.025),
            upper = quantile(Population, probs = 0.975),
            .groups = 'keep') %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = factor(AgeBin, levels = pop_age_labels))

obs.pop.sheet.plot <- obs.pop.sheet.rebin %>%
  filter(Year %in% pop_subset_years) %>%
  mutate(AgeBin = factor(AgeBin, levels = pop_age_labels))
```

## Total population vs time

```{r, fig.width = 8}
pop.data.total <- sim.results %>%
```
